name: manage_media
description: Search, read, and upload WordPress media attachments through one consolidated facade. Use operation=search to find attachments by keyword or mime type, operation=read to inspect one attachment and its available sizes, and operation=upload to create a new attachment through the existing validated upload flow.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Optional media action. Omit operation or use search for discovery, then use read or upload as needed.

parameters.name: mime_type
parameters.description: Optional mime type filter for operation=search, for example image/jpeg.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional requested size for operation=search or read. Falls back to full.

parameters.name: image_data
parameters.description: Required base64 image payload for operation=upload. Data URLs are accepted.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Optional attachment alt text for operation=upload.

output.description: Plain text media results with attachment ids, metadata, available sizes, selected size URLs, or uploaded attachment details.
